_meta.purpose: Reviewed record of every public-authority report of a laboratory-confirmed case of the 2026 Bundibugyo virus outbreak outside the DRC. It is the pricing substrate for the international calibration blocks, read only up to each block's source cutoff and frozen by hash, and after each window it is the resolution evidence that lovs/forecast/opsresolver.py reads.
doctrine: One report per authority report that raises a country's cumulative confirmed count. reported_on is the date the report was first published (or first captured by this programme when the publication date is not stated); confirmed_on is recorded only when the authority states it.

Authorities: WHO (Disease Outbreak News, regional offices, the Director-General), ECDC, US CDC, Africa CDC, and the ministry of health or national public health agency of the reporting country. A press report alone is not a report; it can point to one.

A case counts for the country whose authority reports its laboratory confirmation. A person who travelled through other countries counts only where confirmed (Kenya's 2026-10-06 case counts for Kenya, not Uganda).
new_local_confirmed is recorded only when the authority states how many new cases were acquired in the reporting country; absent, local acquisition is unknown and does not count as local.

Counts follow the authority's cumulative confirmed figure. A probable case reclassified as confirmed, or a retrospective laboratory or serological confirmation, is a report on the day the authority publishes the raised count.
Cited or absent. Every report and retraction names at least one source with publisher, URL and publication date. Live pages carry the sha256 of the programme's capture where one exists.
Counts never fall except through a dated retraction naming the report it withdraws; a retracted report never qualifies once its retraction is published.
Planned medical evacuations, whether the patient was confirmed before or after transfer, are not reports and create no country event. They are listed under medical_evacuations for context.
Append only. A correction is a new report, a retraction or a dated note, never an edit of a published entry.

Silence is not evidence. A pin resolves NO only when a coverage review, naming its sources, covers its window and evidence grace; coverage_reviews records which sources were checked through which date.

baseline_affected_countries.basis: countries lists every country whose authority had reported a laboratory-confirmed case of this outbreak before registration: the DRC; Uganda (first case 2026-05-15); France (2026-06-24); Kenya (2026-10-06). WHO counts the same four and calls Kenya the fourth country to confirm a case. evacuation_only lists countries that have only treated medically evacuated patients confirmed in the DRC (Germany: two US citizens, May and July; the Netherlands: a healthcare worker positive on 2026-09-29) or that an affected-country list names because of them (the United States, listed by ECDC for its citizens). They are not affected for these questions: a case they confirm in a traveller would be their first, while evacuations never count.
